rules.statement: A court has no power to enter an order of abatement under Section 402 of the Civil Procedure Code where the failure to prosecute the action for twelve months after the last order was due to the death of the plaintiff within that period.
rules.supporting_quote: In the case of Selamma Achie Vs Palavasam 41 NLR 186, the Supreme Court held that “ A court has no power to enter an order of abatement under Section 402 of the Civil Procedure Code where the failure to prosecute the action for twelve months after the last order was due to the death of the plaintiff within that period”.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 402 of the Civil Procedure Code
